svg.title: lockstep's parts and the engine seam
svg.desc: Your actors call the runtime in package lockstep: systems and PIDs, mailboxes, asks, supervision, timers and effects. The runtime talks only to the engine seam, an internal interface with a scheduler, a clock, effects, entropy, a transport and a tracer. Two engines implement the seam: the production engine behind lockstep.New, and the simulation engine behind sim.Simulate, which runs on the faultline kernel. lockstep-vet checks your actor code. From https://github.com/hmdsefi/lockstep.
